title: Coach view shows blank screen after BAW upgrade to 23.0.2
description: Since the BAW upgrade last week, users opening the Contract Approval step see a blank white screen instead of the Contract Summary coach. Other coaches in the same process are working fine. This is blocking all contract approvals.

worklogs.description: Reproduced blank coach issue in dev. Browser console shows JavaScript error: 'coach.view.bind is not a function'.
Traced to deprecated API removed in BAW 23.0.2. The tw.coach.view.bind API no longer exists.
Updated coach view JS to use the new tw.coach.context.get/set API. Tested in sandbox.
Deployed updated snapshot to production. Verified coach renders correctly.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: All contract approvers are blocked since Monday morning. Every time they open the task they get a blank screen. We are processing approvals by email which is not sustainable.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I can reproduce this. The browser developer console shows a JavaScript error in the coach view code. This is a compatibility issue with the updated BAW 23.0.2 JavaScript API. A specific API was removed in this version. I will prepare a fix and test it in the sandbox first.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The ContractSummaryCoach uses tw.coach.view.bind() which was removed in 23.0.2. Need to replace with tw.coach.context.get/set. Only one place in the codebase uses the old API.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Fix is ready and tested in sandbox. I will deploy to production at 12:30 during your lunch break to minimize disruption. Takes about 5 minutes.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Deployment complete. Contract Summary coach is working in production. Could you ask one of your approvers to test?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Just tested - everything is showing correctly and the approve/reject buttons work. We processed three backlogged approvals. Thank you for the fast fix.

resolutionNote: The ContractSummaryCoach used the tw.coach.view.bind() API which was removed in BAW 23.0.2. Updated to use the supported tw.coach.context.get/set pattern. New snapshot deployed to production.
